text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
What an appetite! You've got an impressive appetite on you, Trainer <username>!
Chef, another round of sushi, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A colorful array of sushi was laid out on the desk.
I was only able to enjoy such a lavish lunch because I happened to run into her at noon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was right after we finally managed
to clear away the mountain of paperwork—
choice_data_list: I missed lunch, but... f-finally finished...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! If it isn't Trainer <username>!
Are you today as well...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――……Hm?
Hmm? Hmmmm~~……?
Your complexion is…………

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I'm starving!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It all started with one of Chairwoman Akikawa's usual whimsical, offhand remarks.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Your color! It has returned!
I knew you had been skipping meals.
choice_data_list: Huh? How did you know what I was eating...
Huh? How did you know what I was eating...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: One look is all it takes to know.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainers at our academy have a bad habit of neglecting themselves
the moment they get absorbed in their work.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I know your trainee Umamusume is
your number one priority, but still...
Caution! You must not neglect taking care of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You are one of the precious Trainers
of this Tracen Academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Word of how hard of a worker you are
has reached my ears as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She has a tendency to push herself too hard.
In that case, surely there's no harm in someone giving her a little appreciation?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us ask the chef to make more sushi!
Consider it a well-deserved daily treat!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: So full, so full! That was a splendid lunch! Was yours delicious too, Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid fortune! Inviting you was well worth the effort!

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Chairwoman. Haven't seen you since the other day's meeting.
And... who might this be?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, allow me to introduce them!
This is Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you are the Trainer.
I am from the URA...
...Pardon me, might I borrow the Chairwoman for a moment?
choice_data_list: Ah, yes! I don't mind at all, but...
Ah, yes! I don't mind at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then I suppose I'll follow suit.
If it's business from you... would it be regarding the track drainage issue discussed the other day?

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text:
That is correct.
I would like to reconfirm the details regarding
the culvert drainage materials for each racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mhm. That was modeled after Kyoto Racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Then please compile the details regarding guest accommodations for the bid.

text_block_list.name: URA Executive
text_block_list.text: Understood. Then I shall see you later.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed!!
choice_data_list: You certainly have your hands full too, Chairwoman...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
I am truly grateful for that!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It simply means that in their eyes, I have finally become
someone they can trust to handle the work without worry.
choice_data_list: ...? The Chairwoman is very capable, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Excessive praise!
Especially regarding the me of the past.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
When I first succeeded the chairwoman seat from my predecessor,
my passion constantly outran my capability, causing everyone no shortage of worry.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Unable to properly grasp the situation,
nor understand the nature of the business.
I've done nothing but confuse seasoned staff members.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Now, I don't have to put that bewildered look on everyone's faces anymore.
I can carry out my duties as chairwoman without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It's simply the payoff of digging in my heels and refusing to let go.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa! My apologies! Today's lunch was supposed to be in your honor!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Then I must see my hospitality through to the very end!
Now then, which taxi company would be willing to come all the way out here――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then Chairwoman Akikawa opened her pocketbook.
A fleeting glance showed pages crammed solid
with what looked like meticulous notes.
choice_data_list: (……These must be the traces of the Chairwoman studying.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm. This company, then.
Right, all that's left is a phone call—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Hm? What's the matter,
Trainer <username>?
choice_data_list: ...If anything, you're the hard worker here, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
What nonsense are you saying, our academy's pride and joy hard-worker?!
